chunks: From him, from Zurara, similar to it.

And he (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no problem with you buying the green crops or the straw while green, then you leave it if you wish until it grows ears, then you harvest it. And if you wish to feed your animal straw, there is no problem with it before it grows ears. But as for when it has grown ears, do not feed it the whole stalk, for that is spoilage.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on feeding green crops to animals after they have formed ears?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the juristic distinction between permissible commercial speculation and wasteful consumption (fasad) in agricultural trade, a key concept in Shia fiqh regarding the validity of selling unharvested crops. It highlights the practical wisdom of preserving the primary value of the grain (the ear) while allowing for the secondary use of the stalk, reflecting the Shia emphasis on maximizing resource utility without incurring riba-like uncertainty or waste. The ruling underscores the principle that once the main commodity has matured, its primary purpose shifts, and using it entirely for fodder constitutes a diminution of its intended economic value.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Zurara
- similar to it, and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem with you buying the green plants or the straw, then you leave it if you so desire to until it grows seeds, then you harvest it, and if you desire to you feed straw to your animal, for there is no problem with it if it grows sees. So when it grows seeds, so do not feed (your animal), the top part, for it would be spoliing’.
en.sarwar: 3. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Zurarah a similar Hadith.

“He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘It is not unlawful to buy a plantation or greenery, then leave it, if you like, until the ears appear, then harvest, or if you like use it as animal feed as grass and it is not unlawful before ears appear, and when the ears appear then do not use it (ears) as animal feed because it is destroying.’”
